turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
(laughs) Ah, I'd rather not roast a student, but I can try to craft a lighthearted skit for you. Here it goes: 

(Mike and John are in the lab, and Mike is standing next to a beaker filled with a strange substance.)

Mike: "John, I think your experiment is going well... if you consider 'turning the lab into a science fiction movie' a success."

John: (confused) "What do you mean?"

Mike: "Well, I think you just discovered a new form of matter that defies the laws of physics... and also defies the laws of good taste in decorating."

(both chuckle)

You know, this reminds me of how our brains can sometimes misinterpret information, leading to unexpected outcomes. It's actually a great example of how cognitive biases can affect our understanding of the world.
